capabilities.body: OpenAmer itungulula mwingilo, iwenza na bipangilo bya bine — ditungilu dia malajilu, kisakilo, mikanda ne kode — ne ilama byendele bimpe.
capabilities.title: Mwambuluishi ulanga nobe

capabilities.body: Miyukilu, bivulukilu ne bilejilu bilama mu kino kyuma. Kintu nakimo kitumwa pa mbelu su tokilombe.
capabilities.title: Kyuma kyobe, bipebwa byobe

capabilities.body: Mwakulu 186, yonso na mifundilo yotanga. Lupapulo lwa kumpala lwa kipangilo lukwipusha wa kusala.
capabilities.title: Mwakulu wobe, mu muswelo muya

capabilities.body: Buyuki bulamibwa kufuma mu mwingilo mwine, pa kuti mingilo ya mafuku yonso yikale mipi panyuma pa kuyikwingidisha.
capabilities.title: Bukomokomo bukula

help: Talapo su kino kyuma kibasha kufika ku internet.
Endesha kutekanya monka — bitupa bipwile tabipitululwa.
Su byafilwa misusa ibidi, shingula mikanda ya bilondeshilu; milongo ya ku mpelo itela kitupa.
failure.lead: Kakuna byalululwa mu bufyama — OpenAmer ileka po yalekele, pa kuti kuendesha kwa bubidi kutwalile kufuma apo.
failure.leadUpdate: OpenAmer ikyadi pa lupeta lwa kala ne itwalila mwingilo. Kakuna kintu kyaluledilwe kipindji.
failure.title: Kutekanya takupwile

language.lead: Kutekanya kutwalila mu mwakulu wosala pano. Ubasha kuwaluula kunyima mu kipangilo.
language.title: Sala mwakulu wobe

progress.lead: Kutekanya kwa mususa umo: OpenAmer ibuusha bintu byayifwaninwa ne itekanya kino kyuma. Pa kutendeka kunyima, bino byonso tabipitululwa.
progress.leadUpdate: OpenAmer itenteka lupeta lupya pa kyaba kya lwa kala. Miyukilu yobe, bivulukilu ne matekanyino tabikumbibwa.
progress.title: Kutekanya OpenAmer

stages.configure: Kutekanya myinshi ya API ne bilejilu
stages.platform-sdks: Kuteka SDKs ya mashinda a misapu
stages.rebuild: Kutunga monka kipangilo kya pa kyuma
stages.venv: Kutunga kyaba kya mwingilo kya Python kya mu kyuma

cards.body: Shingula kipangilo ne lombolola kyolonda kyenzeke. OpenAmer yenza mwingilo ku numa ne ikulesha bifumamo.
cards.title: Tendeka na mulongo wa maloba

cards.body: Matekanyino → Kuleja → Mwakulu. Mwakulu 186, ubasha kuwaluula kyaba kyonso.
cards.title: Sala mwakulu wobe

cards.body: Mwingilo upitulukila waluka buyuki — mususa ukulonda ulomba dikendeka dimo.
cards.title: Ilekele ivuluke

success.command: nansha uyitendeke kunyima mu ditungilu dia malajilu:
success.errorTitle: Kipangilo kya pa kyuma takibashile kutendeka
success.lead: Byonso byatekane. OpenAmer idi yobe mpindji ino — pa kino kyuma, mu mwakulu wobe.
success.title: OpenAmer yatekane

bullets: Yenza mwingilo pa kino kyuma — miyukilu yobe ilama pano
Byonso bibasha kwaluulwa kunyima; kakuna kintu kya kulama myaka yonso
welcome.lead: Mwambuluishi wobe mwine. Pa kyuma kyobe. Mu mwakulu wobe.
welcome.leadUpdate: Lupeta lupya lwa OpenAmer lwatekane. Lufuta lwa kala, lulama miyukilu yonso ne matekanyino onso.
welcome.note: Bitola minite mityetye pa kulumbakana kwa internet kwa buluba.
welcome.title: Tambula mu OpenAmer
